program:
PARAMS = {
    "L1":   (0.40, 0.25, 1.0),     # input NMOS length (sets gds1 -> gain/f3db balance)
    "I1":   (70e-6, 50e-6, 85e-6), # main branch current (sets gm -> GBW)
    "gmp":  (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),      # PMOS load/mirror gm/Id (low -> small gm, decent vdsat)
    "Lp":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # PMOS load length
    "Ibp":  (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),  # PMOS mirror reference branch current
    "Lb":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # NMOS bias-mirror length
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vo = 0.9                         # intended output DC level
    L1, I1, gmp, Lp, Ibp, Lb = p["L1"], p["I1"], p["gmp"], p["Lp"], p["Ibp"], p["Lb"]

    # ---- NMOS bias mirror: ibias diode -> sink Ibp from PMOS diode
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)          # diode: vds = vgs
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, Ibp, vds=0.65)

    # ---- PMOS diode (reference) and load sharing its VSG
    pd = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, Ibp, vds=0.9)
    pd = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, Ibp, vds=pd.vgs)
    vsgp = abs(pd.vgs)
    ip_per_um = abs(lut.op("p", 1.0, Lp, vsgp, vdd - vo)["Id"])
    W2 = I1 / ip_per_um
    op2 = lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsgp, vdd - vo)

    # ---- input NMOS sized so Id(VGS=vin_dc, VDS=vo) = I1 exactly
    in_per_um = abs(lut.op("n", 1.0, L1, vin, vo)["Id"])
    W1 = I1 / in_per_um
    W1 = min(max(W1, 0.42), 4000.0)
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vo)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", pd)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, Lp)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)

    # ---- predictions
    gm1 = abs(op1["gm"]); gds1 = abs(op1["gds"]); gds2 = abs(op2["gds"])
    # output parasitics: approximate drain cap from LUT of scaled devices
    cpar = 0.0
    try:
        s1 = lut.size("n", max(abs(op1["gm_id"]), 3.0), L1, I1, vds=vo)
        s2 = lut.size("p", gmp, Lp, I1, vds=vdd - vo)
        cpar = abs(s1.cdd) + abs(s2.cdd) + abs(s1.cgd)
    except Exception:
        cpar = 0.05 * cl
    ctot = cl + cpar
    gain = gm1 / (gds1 + gds2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = (gds1 + gds2) / (2 * PI * ctot)
    power = vdd * (I1 + Ibp + iref)
    vdsat1 = abs(op1.get("vdsat", 0.15)); vdsat2 = abs(op2.get("vdsat", 0.2))
    swing = (vdd - vdsat2 - 0.05) - (vdsat1 + 0.05)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
